req.title: Reject empty firstName
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the Player payload contains an empty firstName.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject a Player payload with an empty firstName by returning an HTTP 422 status code. This behavior needs to be validated through a series of tests that cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_post_player_with_valid_first_name
preconditions: The database is empty or contains no player with the same squad number.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a valid Player payload including a non-empty firstName.
expected: The response contains a valid PlayerResponseModel.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_payload = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "Team A",
    "league": "League 1",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=player_payload)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert "id" in response.json()

tests.name: test_post_player_with_empty_first_name
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a Player payload where firstName is an empty string.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating validation failure.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_payload = {
    "firstName": "",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 11,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "Team B",
    "league": "League 2",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=player_payload)
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "Unprocessable Entity" in response.text
